description: Source code for handling CFF hints in font rendering, including hint initialization, hint map building, hint adjustment, and glyph path construction with hinting and darkening offsets.

classes.name: CF2_HintMoveRec
classes.description: Structure representing a hint move adjustment with index and move amount.

methods.name: cf2_hint_init
methods.description: Constructs a hint from a stem hint, adjusting for darkening and hint origin.

methods.name: cf2_hint_initZero
methods.description: Initializes a hint to an invalid state.

methods.name: cf2_hintmap_build
methods.description: Builds a hint map from hints and mask, adjusting hint positions and locking.

methods.name: cf2_hintmap_adjustHints
methods.description: Adjusts hint edges in device space to prevent overlaps and optimize positions.

methods.name: cf2_hintmap_insertHint
methods.description: Inserts hint edges into the hint map, maintaining sorted order and avoiding overlaps.

methods.name: cf2_glyphpath_init
methods.description: Initializes glyph path structure with font, callbacks, hints, and transformations.

methods.name: cf2_glyphpath_hintPoint
methods.description: Hints a point in y-direction and applies outer transform to produce device coordinates.

methods.name: cf2_glyphpath_computeIntersection
methods.description: Computes intersection point of two line segments, with snapping and limit checks.

methods.name: cf2_glyphpath_pushPrevElem
methods.description: Pushes previous path element to outline, adjusting for intersections and hinting.

methods.name: cf2_glyphpath_moveTo
methods.description: Starts a new subpath with a move, building hint map if needed.

methods.name: cf2_glyphpath_lineTo
methods.description: Adds a line segment to the path, with hinting and zero-length optimization.

methods.name: cf2_glyphpath_curveTo
methods.description: Adds a cubic Bezier curve to the path, with hinting and offset computation.

methods.name: cf2_glyphpath_closeOpenPath
methods.description: Closes an open path by connecting to start point, with hint map updates.
